body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/39096
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/689

Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/529 at `fc25fb0ed902605ed7aaf5592a72e42979219965`
Independent review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/674

## Summary

- preserve the candidate's valid fix for scalar chat sampling precedence: explicit client value > preferred server value > generation config/protocol default
- treat explicitly absent converted keys as removals, allowing `response_format={"type":"text"}` to clear preferred constraints
- treat `json_schema`, `regex`, `ebnf`, and `structural_tag` as a mutually exclusive precedence group so an explicit constraint removes preferred constraints of other kinds
- carry required or named tool-call constraints as explicit metadata so a derived client constraint cannot be overwritten by `--preferred-sampling-params`

## Failing before

I applied the exact candidate commit to its parent/base and added regressions for the review counterexamples. Against the candidate implementation, the focused test failed: a required-tool regex had no explicit-key representation, explicit text retained preferred `json_schema` and `structural_tag`, and cross-kind preferences survived explicit constraints. Raw output is retained at `/job/candidate-counterexamples-failing.txt`.

## Passing after

```text
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-86dfb457f3bb/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_chat_preferred_sampling_params.py \
  test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_protocol.py

51 passed, 28 subtests passed
```

The tests exercise the real `SamplingParams.verify(vocab_size=100)` path for explicit text, regex, EBNF, and JSON-schema cross-kind cases. The focused pre-commit checks also pass.

One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X completed a float64 CPU-reference comparison exactly. This is environment evidence only; the corrected behavior is entirely in the CPU request conversion and tokenizer-manager merge path.

## Limitations

No model-backed startup was run because no model weights were prepared and startup would not establish this precedence contract. No native/C++ source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. Full commands and claims are recorded in `reports/j-86dfb457f3bb/result.json`.
